company.shortDescription: Chat and voice-based app that instantly recommends and delivers beer, wine, and spirits with the push of a button.
company.description:
Handoff is a chat and voice-based app that instantly recommends and delivers beer, wine, and spirits with the touch of a button. 

The nation's first, full-service alcohol delivery solution supported on Alexa and Google Home devices. 

Handoff partners with local liquor retailers to offer unrivaled selection, prices and delivery service to your doorstep. We are revolutionizing the delivery economy by bringing local businesses into the future landscape of attention. Currently operating in Denver and Boulder, Colorado with further domestic expansion efforts in motion.
